purpose: Capture the missing guest failure from the finalized minimal-v6 plus K-OVERLAY-PIDNS-001 B3 interval using debugConsole as the only runtime delta.

classification.basis: The diagnostic GuestLog stream proves that the registered ext4 filesystem mounted and overlay construction succeeded, then the intentionally absent cross-distro share move failed with ENOENT before CreateInstanceResult.

candidate.diagnosticDelta: transactional debugConsole=true with exact wslrelay cleanup

candidateInterval.failureSignature: LaunchDistro retried an absent cross-distro shared mount after successful overlay construction and exited with ENOENT before CreateInstanceResult

sourceFinding.retainedBlock: LaunchDistro unconditionally calls AddTemporaryMount for CROSS_DISTRO_SHARE_PATH at lines 1701-1732
sourceFinding.mechanism: The first ENOENT enters a broad catch intended for read-only/full filesystems; overlay creation succeeds, but the same absent cross-distro mount is retried and fails again.

decision: Finalize this diagnostic at B3 without rerun. The evidence selects a new control-plane source layer that removes only the excluded LaunchDistro cross-distro temporary-mount block. Repeat policy, mutation, and two-build reproducibility gates, then retest the unchanged overlay-plus-PID kernel; do not add a Kconfig group.
